top_jobs.job: When the store or checkout stops taking orders at night, on a weekend or on one payment method, help me know within minutes and where it broke, so I stop paying for ads that send shoppers who cannot buy
top_jobs.metric: minutes from checkout breaking to someone being told, per incident

top_jobs.job: When a developer, an agency or I change the theme, add an app or edit a setting, help me make the change on a copy, walk the buying flow and check the numbers the next morning, so I never lose a week of sales to one change
top_jobs.metric: days a break stays live before it is found, per incident

top_jobs.job: When app bills stack up and old app code stays in the theme after the app is gone, help me see which apps earn nothing and what they cost in fees and lost sales, so I cut both
top_jobs.metric: monthly app bill, and seconds of load time added by apps on product pages

top_jobs.job: When paid orders stall, stock is wrong or money leaks out after the sale, help me find them before the customer writes in, so I never forget a paid order or lose margin I cannot see
top_jobs.metric: paid orders not shipped past the promised ship date, count, daily

top_jobs.job: When a sale, a launch, a new country or a peak day is coming, help me prove the store is ready with real orders and timed checks, so I do not watch it fail on the best day
top_jobs.metric: minutes from scheduled promo start to confirmed live, per promo

jobs.job: Run a scripted test shopper through product, cart, discount and checkout every 15 minutes, and alert a named person when a step fails twice in a row
jobs.trigger: every 15 minutes, always on

inputs.need: store product, cart and checkout pages
a hidden test product and a test discount code that zeroes the price
a browser check tool that clicks through checkout from 2 regions
who gets the alert at night and on weekends

steps: Write the path: open product, pick a size, add to cart, apply the test code, reach payment
Run it every 15 minutes from 2 regions on a phone-sized screen
Alert by text when a step fails twice in a row, naming the step and a screenshot
Check the alert against orders per hour so one bad run does not wake anyone
Review false alarms monthly and tune the rule
jobs.output: a live check with an alert that names the broken step, and a monthly false alarm count
jobs.next: incidents feed 06-07 (was it a change) and 06-02 (revenue lost)

watch.metric: minutes from checkout breaking to someone being told

jobs.job: Compare orders per hour with the same hour over the last 4 weeks and flag any trading hour with none where 3 or more are normal, with an estimate of sales lost
jobs.trigger: every hour

inputs.need: orders with timestamps, 8 weeks
ad spend by hour
average order value, 30 days

steps: Compute the normal orders for each hour of each weekday from the last 4 weeks
Flag an hour with 0 orders where the normal is 3 or more, while ads are spending
Estimate lost sales in code: normal orders minus actual, times average order value
Send the alert with ad spend running in the same hour
Log each incident with cause once found
jobs.output: an hourly zero-order alert and a monthly total of sales lost to gaps
jobs.next: feeds 06-01 tuning and the 00-today morning line

watch.metric: hours with no orders in normal trading hours

jobs.job: Check checkout completion by payment method each week (card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal, Shop Pay, pay later) and place one real order on any method that falls 10 points behind cards
jobs.trigger: every Monday, and after any checkout or payment app change

inputs.need: checkouts and orders by payment gateway, 7 days
a real card and wallet to place and refund test orders
recent checkout and app changes

steps: Compute completion rate per method from checkouts started and orders, in code
Flag any method 10 points or more behind cards
Place a real order on that method on an iPhone and an Android, then refund it
Match the fall with the change log to name the likely cause
Fix or hide the broken method and recheck in 7 days
jobs.output: a weekly table of completion by payment method, with any broken method fixed or hidden
jobs.next: feeds 06-07 when a change caused it

watch.metric: checkout completion rate by payment method

jobs.job: Send a test order through every order, shipping and refund email each week, and a test message through the contact form and chat, and flag any that did not arrive
jobs.trigger: every Monday, and after any email, helpdesk or domain change

inputs.need: order, shipping and refund notification settings
contact form and chat routing
a test inbox on Gmail, Outlook and Yahoo

steps: Place a test order, mark it shipped, then refund it
Check each email arrived in the inbox, not spam, with working links and the right logo
Send a message through the contact form and chat and check it lands in the helpdesk
Flag any missing or broken message with the step
Fix and retest the same day
jobs.output: a weekly pass or fail sheet for 6 emails and 2 contact paths
jobs.next: failures feed 14-17 (sender domain health)

watch.metric: 'where is my order' tickets per 100 orders

jobs.job: Check checkout settings against a short list (guest checkout on, 7 fields or fewer, express wallets first, address autocomplete on, shipping cost shown in the cart) and change the ones that fail
jobs.trigger: once, then each quarter and after a platform checkout update

inputs.need: checkout settings and field list
checkout step drop-off on mobile
checkout ideas with steps

steps: Screenshot each checkout step on a phone
Tick each item on the list and note what fails
Pull mobile drop-off per step to see where shoppers quit
Change one setting at a time and log it in the change log
Read checkout to order rate 14 days before and after each change
jobs.output: a checkout with guest on, fewer fields and wallets first, and a before and after read for each change
jobs.next: feeds 07-17 test reads when traffic allows a real test

watch.metric: checkout to order rate, mobile

jobs.job: Log every theme edit, app install or removal, setting, price and discount change with who, when and what, from the store's activity feed and a form for outside developers
jobs.trigger: on every change, always on

inputs.need: store activity feed, app install and uninstall events, theme publish events
a 3 field change form for agencies and developers
who works on the store

steps: Pull the activity feed and app events into one dated list
Send outside developers the form: what changed, which pages, how to undo it
Match each change to a person
Mark changes that touch product pages, cart or checkout as high risk
Post a daily digest to the founder
jobs.output: one dated change list with owner, pages touched, risk and the way back
jobs.next: feeds 06-07 (morning after check) and 08-15 (speed budget check)

watch.metric: changes logged with an owner and a way back, share

jobs.drives: days a break stays live before it is found

jobs.job: The morning after any change, compare add to cart, checkout start, discount use and orders with the 14 day average for that weekday, and name the change if a step fell
jobs.trigger: every morning after a logged change

inputs.need: the change list
add to cart and checkout start by page and device
orders and discount code use

steps: Take yesterday's changes from the log
Compute each step rate against the same weekday average over 14 days, in code
Flag any step down 15 percent or more on the pages the change touched
Name the change and the person, with the rollback steps
Founder or developer rolls back or fixes the same day
jobs.output: a morning note: 'add to cart on product pages fell 22 percent after the upsell app went in, roll back?'
jobs.next: feeds 06-09 (rollback) and settles blame between ads and site in 11-paid-social

watch.metric: add to cart rate and checkout start rate, day after change vs 14 day average

jobs.job: Duplicate the live theme before every app install or theme edit, make the change on the copy, walk the full buying flow on a phone, and publish only when it passes
jobs.trigger: before every theme edit or app install

inputs.need: theme access and the duplicate theme feature
a 12 step flow checklist: product, size, add to cart, cart drawer, discount, shipping, checkout, pay, emails
an iPhone and a mid-range Android

steps: Duplicate the live theme and name it with the date and change
Make the change on the copy only
Walk the 12 step flow on the copy on both phones, and run the same speed test on both themes
Fix anything the copy broke, then publish it
Keep the old theme for 14 days as the way back
jobs.output: a change that went live only after passing the flow and speed check, with the old theme kept for rollback
jobs.next: speed results feed 08-12; publishes feed 06-06 change log

watch.metric: changes that broke cart, discount or checkout after publish, count

jobs.job: Keep a nightly backup of the theme, products, collections and settings, and practise a rollback to yesterday once a quarter
jobs.trigger: nightly, and a quarterly drill

inputs.need: theme, product, collection and settings data
a backup app that restores products and themes
who may run a restore

steps: Install the backup app and check it covers products, images, metafields, theme and pages
Confirm the nightly backup ran each morning
Once a quarter, restore one product and one theme file on a copy and time it
Write the 5 step restore guide and store it with the change log
jobs.output: nightly backups, a tested restore time in minutes, and a written guide
jobs.next: used by 06-07 when a change must be undone

watch.metric: minutes to restore after a bad import or wipe

jobs.drives: days lost to a bad import or click

jobs.job: List every installed app with its monthly bill, when it was last used, which pages load its script, and the orders it touched in 90 days, and mark keep, replace or remove
jobs.trigger: once at onboarding, then each quarter

inputs.need: installed apps and app charges
scripts and app embeds per page
orders or revenue each app reports (upsells, reviews, bundles)
which apps the team still uses

steps: Pull the app list with monthly charges
Map each app to the pages its script loads on
Pull what each app touched in 90 days: orders, reviews shown, emails sent
Ask the team which apps they open each week
Mark keep, replace with a native feature, or remove, and total the monthly saving
jobs.output: an app table: bill, pages, what it touched, and a keep, replace or remove call with the monthly saving
jobs.next: feeds 06-11 (clean leftover code) and 08-07 (script list)

watch.metric: monthly app bill

jobs.drives: operating cost per month and product page speed

jobs.job: Search the theme for code left by apps that were removed, delete it on a theme copy, walk the buying flow, and measure the speed and sales before and after
jobs.trigger: after each app removal, and once as a sweep at onboarding

inputs.need: apps removed in the last 2 years, from billing history
theme code
page speed on mobile before and after

steps: List every app ever billed but no longer installed
Search the theme for their names, script domains and snippet files
Delete the leftovers on a theme copy
Walk the buying flow on the copy and run the same speed test on both themes
Publish if it passes and log seconds saved
jobs.output: a clean theme with leftover app code removed, and seconds saved per page type
jobs.next: feeds 06-12 (dollars per app) and 08-09

watch.metric: mobile load time on product pages
watch.source: PageSpeed Insights and Chrome field data

jobs.job: Put a dollar figure on each app: its bill plus the sales lost to the load time it adds, using our own conversion rate by page load time
jobs.trigger: each quarter, and before any new app is approved

inputs.need: sessions with page load time and orders
inputs.from: GA4 with a load time event

inputs.need: load time with and without each app on a theme copy
app bills
average order value and sessions per page

steps: Bucket sessions by load time and compute conversion per bucket, in code
Measure each app's added seconds with a with and without test on a theme copy
Estimate lost sales per month: sessions times the conversion drop for those seconds times average order value
Add the monthly bill
Rank apps by total cost and show it next to the sales each app claims
jobs.output: a ranked table: app, bill, seconds added, estimated sales lost per month, and sales it claims
jobs.next: feeds 08-08 speed revenue model and the 21-finance-cash app line

watch.metric: monthly cost of apps, bill plus estimated lost sales

jobs.drives: apps kept only where they earn more than they cost

jobs.job: List every paid order past its promised ship date each morning, with the reason: payment pending, fraud hold, address problem, failed warehouse sync or out of stock
jobs.trigger: every morning

inputs.need: orders with payment, fulfilment status and tags
promised ship days per product and market
warehouse shipment confirmations

steps: Pull paid orders not fulfilled
Compare each with its promised ship date
Tag the reason from status, tags and the warehouse feed
Hide known preorders so the list stays real
Send the list to ops with the oldest first, and to support for a heads-up email
jobs.output: a morning list of late paid orders with reason and age
jobs.next: feeds 15-customers-cx heads-up emails to delayed buyers

watch.metric: paid orders not shipped past the promised ship date, count

jobs.job: Compare store stock with warehouse stock per SKU every day and stop selling any SKU where the store shows more than the warehouse holds
jobs.trigger: daily

inputs.need: inventory per SKU
stock on hand per SKU
SKUs allowed to sell on backorder

steps: Pull both stock counts per SKU
Flag SKUs where the store count is higher than the warehouse count
Skip SKUs allowed on backorder
Set the store count to the warehouse count or pause the SKU, with ops approval
Count orders cancelled for no stock each month
jobs.output: a daily stock gap list and a monthly count of orders cancelled for no stock
jobs.next: feeds 19-supply-inventory reorder alerts

watch.metric: orders cancelled for no stock, count

jobs.job: Put the three legs of reversed orders side by side each month (returns, return to origin where cash on delivery exists, chargebacks) with cost per leg and the top 3 causes each
jobs.trigger: on the 1st of each month

inputs.need: refunds and returns with reasons
chargebacks and disputes
return reasons from the returns app
what a return or failed delivery really costs

steps: Count each leg and its value, computed in code; return to origin reads unavailable for US stores
Cost each leg: shipping both ways, restocking, write-offs, fees
List the top 3 causes per leg
Name the leg that cost most this month
Hand the top cause to its owner: product, CX, fraud or delivery
jobs.output: a one page table: 3 legs, count, value, cost, top causes, owner
jobs.next: fit causes feed 07-13 (fit finder) and 14-03 (fit email before delivery)

watch.metric: cost of reversed orders, share of revenue

jobs.job: Hold orders that look like card testing or fraud before they ship, and answer the chargebacks we can win with proof of delivery within the deadline
jobs.trigger: daily for holds, and within 5 days of each chargeback

inputs.need: orders with fraud risk flags, IP, address and payment attempts
chargebacks with reason and deadline
tracking and proof of delivery

steps: Flag bursts of small orders, many declines on one session, and billing and shipping far apart
Hold flagged orders and have ops approve or cancel within 24 hours
For each chargeback, pull tracking, delivery proof and the customer's messages
Answer the winnable ones before the deadline and log win or loss
Count chargebacks from confusion, like an unclear billing name, and fix the cause
jobs.output: a daily hold list and a chargeback file per case, with a win rate per month
jobs.next: confusion causes feed 15-customers-cx

watch.metric: chargeback rate, share of orders

jobs.job: Find products live without a cost, weight or SKU, and the shipping zones and weights where what the shopper pays is below the label cost
jobs.trigger: weekly, and after any catalog import

inputs.need: products with cost, weight and SKU fields
shipping charged per order
label cost per shipment

steps: List live products missing cost, weight or SKU
Send the list to the catalog owner to fill
Match shipping charged with label cost per order
Group the loss by zone and weight band, computed in code
Propose a rate change or a free shipping threshold for the worst 3 bands
jobs.output: a list of products to fix and a table of zones and weights that lose money on shipping
jobs.next: feeds 04-offers-pricing (free shipping threshold) and 21-finance-cash

watch.metric: shipping loss per order

jobs.drives: gross profit per order and trusted margin reports

jobs.job: Check at the minute a sale starts and ends that prices, codes, banners and scheduled emails changed as planned, and message the founder 'live' or what is not
jobs.trigger: at each scheduled promo start and end

inputs.need: scheduled discounts and price changes
the promo plan: products, prices, codes, banner text, start and end
scheduled campaign sends

steps: Read the plan and list every thing that should change
At start plus 5 minutes, open each product, apply each code and read each banner
Check the scheduled email went and links land on the sale
Message the founder 'live' or name what is not
Repeat at the end and confirm the sale is gone everywhere
jobs.output: a live or not-live message at start and end, with each item ticked
jobs.next: failures feed 06-06 (log the cause) and 05-16 (sweep ended offers)

watch.metric: minutes from scheduled promo start to confirmed live

jobs.job: Two weeks before Black Friday or a drop, run a readiness list: freeze theme changes, test every discount stack, check the plan and app limits for 10 times traffic, confirm stock and carrier cutoffs, name who is on call
jobs.trigger: 2 weeks before each peak or drop

inputs.need: peak dates and what went wrong last year
discount codes and automatic discounts
stock per SKU and carrier cutoff dates
team on call

steps: Freeze theme and app changes from 7 days out, logged in the change log
Test every discount combination shoppers could stack
Check host and app limits for 10 times normal orders per hour
Confirm stock cover for the top 20 SKUs and the last ship date
Name who is on call each hour of the peak and share the rollback steps
jobs.output: a signed readiness list with each item passed or fixed, and an on-call rota
jobs.next: feeds 08-16 (peak speed test) and 14 peak send plan

watch.metric: checkout errors and zero-order hours during the peak

jobs.job: Before a launch, relaunch or new country, place real orders end to end per market (price, tax, shipping, payment, emails, refund) and fix every step that fails
jobs.trigger: before each launch or new market

inputs.need: market settings per country
per-market facts: currency, tax line, shipping promise, payment methods
a real card and a local address per market

steps: List each market and the payment methods shown there
Place a real order per market and per main payment method
Check price, tax, shipping cost, delivery promise and emails against the market shelf
Refund each order and check the refund email
Fix failures and rerun until all pass
jobs.output: a pass sheet per market and payment method, signed before ads go live
jobs.next: none

watch.metric: failed or abandoned first orders in the new market

new_enablers.name: Checkout probe
new_enablers.what: A scripted shopper that runs the buying path (product, cart, discount, checkout, payment) on a schedule, plus an orders-per-hour watch against the normal level for that hour, plus a check that order, shipping and refund emails and the contact form arrive. Alerts a named person when a step fails twice.
inputs: a test product and a test discount code
an alert channel and an on-call name
powers: launch and new market test orders

new_enablers.name: Store change log
new_enablers.what: Records every theme edit, app install or removal, setting, price and discount change with who, when and what, from the store's activity feed plus a short form for agencies and developers. The morning after each change it compares add to cart, checkout start, discount use and orders with the 14 day average and names the change if a step fell.
inputs: store platform activity and app install events
a change form for outside developers
powers: the break found the next morning, not after a week
facts to settle 'is it the ads or the site'
a rollback point for every change

new_enablers.name: Order and money leak watch
new_enablers.what: Lists paid orders past their ship date with the reason, stock gaps between store and warehouse, products missing cost, weight or SKU, shipping charged below label cost, fraud patterns, and the three legs of reversed orders (returns, return to origin, chargebacks) with cost per leg.
inputs: store orders, fulfilments, refunds and disputes
warehouse or 3PL stock and shipment feed
label costs from the shipping app
cost per return from the founder
